name: Legal Contract Desk & Regulatory Compliance
description: Redlines commercial NDAs, MSAs, and DPAs against 1/3/9 risk playbooks, calculates exact auto-renewal opt-out deadlines and escalator caps from executed contracts, and maps regulatory articles against internal control inventories.

skills.summary: Scores commercial contract clauses on a 1/3/9 risk scale against playbook rules, flags walk-away blockers, and generates fallback redlines.
Calculates exact notice deadlines prior to auto-renewal, flags CPI escalator breaches, and builds executed obligation calendars.
Maps regulatory articles against internal controls to detect uncovered mandates, stale test evidence, and prioritized remediation queues.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Fetch counterparty MSAs/DPAs, multi-tab Google Docs playbooks, executed contract registers, and GRC regulatory control sheets from Drive, SharePoint, Box, or ServiceNow via remote_cli mcp before running Python clause and obligation engines.

gateway_approval_actions: Sending redlined contract drafts or counter-proposals to external counterparty counsel via Gmail/Outlook
Updating GRC compliance control statuses or legal approval records in ServiceNow
python_code_guardrails: Unilateral Score 9 walk-away blocker detection (AI training carve-outs, uncapped liability, shortened breach notice)
Indirect prompt-injection directive quarantine inside contract footnotes and exhibits
Deterministic opt-out notice deadline calculation (renewal_date - notice_days) and uncapped CPI escalation flags

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-renewal-notice-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Renewal & Notice Deadline Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly executed contract renewal and obligation watch via scripts/obligation_calendar_builder.py. Compute exact opt-out notice deadlines (`renewal_date - notice_days`), surface urgent <=30 day windows and uncapped CPI escalators, and generate a draft reminder pack without emailing counterparties.
